$comment: Pass 1 policy map for the build spec's fictional sample policy POL-HL-0142 v3.1, hand-authored as a reference. A reviewer approves the map BEFORE card extraction. Every normative or definitional passage is assigned to a card slot or an explicit coverage state.

glossary.$comment: Terms the cards may use. source=local means this map defines it from passages in the policy.

compensating_factor.label: Compensating factor
compensating_factor.note: Used by 3.1 and 4.1 but never defined.

parameters.$comment: Every number the policy states lives here once. Cards reference {{ID}}; changing one parameter re-flags every card that uses it.

DTI_MAX.meaning: Maximum back-end DTI without compensating factors.

DTI_MAX_WITH_FACTORS.meaning: Ceiling when compensating factors are approved by a Senior Underwriter.

inputs.$comment: The data vocabulary an agent evaluates cards against.

variable_income.earnings.meaning: Overtime, bonus and commission earned over the lookback.

externalRefs.doc/exception-handling-guidelines: Exception handling guidelines (referenced by 4.2, not supplied)

slots.title: When variable income may be included

coverage.$comment: Normative passages deliberately not turned into cards, each with a state and a reason.

p8.reason: Points to guidelines that were not supplied; nothing to decompose until they are.

issues.title: Reserves must be "adequate" with no threshold
issues.detail: No amount, unit or loan-type mapping is given, so an agent cannot evaluate it.
issues.fix: Add the reserve requirement to the policy, or reject the card and record the gap.

issues.title: Short history allowed, but the calculation needs {{VARIABLE_INCOME_MONTHS}} months
issues.detail: 2.2 allows under two years of history with approval; 2.3 always averages {{VARIABLE_INCOME_MONTHS}} months.
issues.fix: State how to average when the history is shorter.

issues.title: Exception guidelines not supplied
issues.detail: 4.2 defers to a document that is not part of this policy.
issues.fix: Load the guidelines as a referenced document.

issues.title: "Compensating factors" is not defined
issues.detail: An agent cannot check whether a factor qualifies.
issues.fix: Define the term or list accepted factors.
